notReplayed.listOrganizationProjects#200 ListAnOrgan: The project belongs to Powerful Abolitionist team; its precondition requires createTeamProject or addProjectTeam, neither served nor called by the demanded applications. The bootstrap and createOrganizationProject do not seed that affiliation. Source: api/spec/openapi.json.gz, ListAnOrganization'sProjects.team/teams.
notReplayed.createOrganizationProject#201 ProjectSuc: The response has two teams. Its precondition requires addProjectTeam after a project exists, which the pack does not serve and no demanded application calls. Source: api/spec/openapi.json.gz, ProjectSuccessfullyCreated.teams.
notReplayed.listOrganizationReleases#200 ReturnAList: The release response includes lastDeploy. Its setup requires createOrganizationReleaseDeploy, a gap operation not called by demanded applications. Source: api/spec/openapi.json.gz, ReturnAListOfReleasesForAnOrganization.
notReplayed.updateOrganizationRelease#200 RetrieveRe: The release has a lastDeploy and integration-backed commit/pull-request state. Its setup requires createOrganizationReleaseDeploy and installing a source-code integration, neither called by demanded applications. Source: api/spec/openapi.json.gz, RetrieveReleaseDetails.lastDeploy/lastCommit.
notReplayed.listOrganizationRepos#200 OrganizationRe: The repository sentry/sentry requires the account Settings > Integrations source-control installation. No demanded application installs that integration; sentry-cli only reads the account repositories. Source: api/spec/openapi.json.gz, OrganizationRepositories; https://docs.sentry.io/organization/integrations/source-code-mgmt/github/.
notReplayed.getProjectEvent#200 ReturnAnIssueEvent: The event names a release whose lastDeploy was created. That precondition requires createOrganizationReleaseDeploy, a gap operation no demanded application calls. The response also contains symbolication data; the example is not fabricated by directly seeding an event. Source: api/spec/openapi.json.gz, ReturnAnIssueEvent.release.lastDeploy.
notReplayed.listProjectKeys#200 ListClientKeysForAPr: The response contains two separately named client keys, Liked Pegasus and Default. Its precondition requires createProjectKey, which the pack does not serve and no demanded application calls. Source: api/spec/openapi.json.gz, ListClientKeysForAProject.
notReplayed.getOrganizationIssue#200 ReturnAnIssue: The response includes an assigned member and subscriber state. Its setup requires addOrganizationMember and updateOrganizationIssues, gap operations no demanded application calls. Source: api/spec/openapi.json.gz, ReturnAnIssue.assignedTo/isSubscribed.
